props.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight

sections.content: The Long Kiss Goodnight represents peak 90s action-thriller craftsmanship, powered by Geena Davis's electric dual performance as an amnesiac housewife discovering she's a trained assassin. Shane Black's razor-sharp script delivers his signature witty dialogue and explosive set pieces, while Renny Harlin directs with the same muscular energy he brought to Die Hard 2 (1990). The film sits perfectly alongside other 90s female-led action films like Point of Break (1991) and La Femme Nikita (1990), but cranks up both the violence and clever one-liners. La Femme Nikita|1990|Luc Besson's influential thriller about a criminal transformed into a government assassin|Prime Total Recall|1990|An amnesiac construction worker discovers his secret agent past in this Schwarzenegger sci-fi classic|Netflix The Bourne Identity|2002|A CIA assassin with memory loss fights to uncover his true identity|HBO Max

What sets The Long Kiss Goodnight apart is its exploration of identity through the lens of Samantha Caine/Charly Baltimore's dual personas. Unlike similar memory-loss thrillers like Total Recall (1990) or Memento (2000), the film digs deep into the psychological impact of discovering your entire life is a lie. Davis seamlessly transitions between suburban mom and hardened killer, while Samuel L. Jackson provides perfect comedic counterpoint as the private detective drawn into her world.

The film's influence can be seen in later action thrillers like Salt (2010) and Atomic Blonde (2017), which similarly feature female agents navigating complex identities and betrayals. Harlin's direction delivers spectacular practical effects and stunt work that holds up better than many CGI-heavy modern equivalents, particularly during the film's explosive final act on the bridge. Salt|2010|Angelina Jolie stars as a CIA officer accused of being a Russian spy|Netflix Atomic Blonde|2017|A lethal MI6 agent fights through Cold War Berlin|Prime Haywire|2011|A black ops super soldier seeks payback after being betrayed|Hulu SUBHEAD: Legacy and Impact on Action Cinema

The Long Kiss Goodnight helped pave the way for more complex female action heroes, moving beyond the simple "tough girl" tropes of earlier films like Red Sonja (1985). Its influence can be seen in everything from Lucy (2014) to Black Widow (2021), where female protagonists balance lethal capability with deeper character development. The film's commercial underperformance at release sadly delayed this evolution, but its reputation has grown steadily through the years.
